title: NVIDIA: GTC 2026 overview and agenda
summary: NVIDIA said GTC 2026 would run March 16-19 in San Jose, with 1,000+ sessions and a five-layer AI stack spanning energy, chips, infrastructure, models and applications.

title: NVIDIA: Vera Rubin opens agentic AI frontier
summary: NVIDIA announced Vera Rubin as a rack-scale AI factory platform including Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, NVLink 6, ConnectX-9, BlueField-4 DPU and Spectrum-6 Ethernet switch for pretraining, post-training and agentic inference.

title: NVIDIA: Vera CPU purpose-built for agentic AI
summary: NVIDIA launched Vera CPU, claiming 2x efficiency and 50% faster results than traditional rack-scale CPUs; partners include cloud providers and system manufacturers such as Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Supermicro and Taiwan ODMs.

title: NVIDIA: BlueField-4 STX storage architecture
summary: NVIDIA announced BlueField-4 STX and context-memory storage, citing up to 5x token throughput, 4x energy efficiency and storage partners including Dell, HPE, NetApp, VAST Data, WEKA and others.

title: NVIDIA: global robotics leaders take physical AI to the real world
summary: NVIDIA announced physical AI partnerships across robotics, industrial automation and humanoids, with Cosmos, Isaac and GR00T model/framework updates.

title: NVIDIA: DRIVE Hyperion adoption for level 4 vehicles
summary: NVIDIA said BYD, Geely, Isuzu, Nissan and mobility platforms are adopting DRIVE Hyperion for L4-ready vehicles, and highlighted robotaxi deployment plans with Uber.

title: NVIDIA: Vera Rubin ramps into full production
summary: At NVIDIA GTC Taipei, NVIDIA said Vera Rubin is ramping into full production and highlighted Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics with co-packaged optics for million-GPU AI factories.

title: NVIDIA and Microsoft reinvent Windows PCs for personal AI
summary: NVIDIA announced RTX Spark for Windows PCs, with 1 petaflop of AI performance, up to 128GB unified memory and fall availability from OEMs including ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft Surface and MSI.

title: Microsoft: Windows PCs accelerated by NVIDIA RTX Spark
summary: Microsoft said RTX Spark-powered Windows PCs would start with Surface, ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo and MSI, positioning local AI agents as a new PC use case.

title: MediaTek collaborates with NVIDIA on RTX Spark
summary: MediaTek announced its role enabling NVIDIA RTX Spark for Windows 11 PCs, giving the PC theme a possible Arm/SoC partner chain.

title: Vertiv: physical infrastructure for NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI factories
summary: Vertiv said it is contributing DSX SimReady digital power and cooling assets, validated interfaces and repeatable infrastructure blocks for NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI factory reference designs.

title: Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA expands at GTC 2026
summary: Dell marked the two-year anniversary of Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA and introduced PowerEdge XE9812 leveraging NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 for enterprise and neocloud AI infrastructure.

title: Astera Labs: GTC 2026 rack-scale connectivity
summary: Astera Labs presented GTC 2026 content on accelerating rack-scale connectivity for NVIDIA Blackwell and Rubin platforms and scaling AI racks with optics.

title: Synopsys: NVIDIA partnership impact at GTC 2026
summary: Synopsys showcased NVIDIA partnership impact and AI infrastructure ecosystem work at GTC 2026, including links between EDA simulation and accelerated compute.

title: Current market pricing screen
summary: Current public market screens show many AI infrastructure beneficiaries already carry elevated expectations; the report caps action states when reverse-DCF or consensus valuation bridges are incomplete.
